heading: Python SDK and API documentation.
lede: The Python SDK runs on one shared Rust core that hashes, buffers and records provenance. Every Python code block on these pages runs in our CI; the other blocks are copied verbatim from the repository, and a test checks both.

sections.heading: What exists today
body: The SDK and the v1 API are in development. The package is not published to a package index yet, and there is no hosted service. The quickstarts run against a local test instance of the platform with demo data.

Configure the SDK with the environment variables NF_API_URL, NF_API_TOKEN (an API key) and NF_SESSION (the session that receives uploads), or call nf.configure with the same values. Streaming also needs NF_INGEST_TARGET, the host and port of the ingest service.

items.heading: Python SDK on the shared core
items.body: Canonical hashing, retries, the encrypted stream buffer and the offline provenance recorder run in the Rust core. Built, tested internally (SDK tests: 25 passed, 2 skipped; M4 report, 2026-09-26); not published.

items.heading: Published package and wheels
items.body: Wheels for Windows, macOS and Linux are built and signed in CI; publishing needs the owner's approval.

items.heading: C ABI, Unity and Unreal
items.body: A stable C interface with a C++17 wrapper and Unity and Unreal SDKs on it: in development, not released.

items.heading: Syncing the offline provenance chain
items.body: The local chain is recorded and verified today; the upload endpoint is designed.

sections.heading: Quickstarts
body: Each quickstart is a short script. Run the blocks in order in one Python session.

sections.heading: Reference
body: The API reference is generated from the OpenAPI document of the v1 API. Errors use RFC 9457 problem documents; the SDK raises them as NfApiError with the status and the problem fields.
